components.label: Accordion
components.summary: A collapsible disclosure list; each AccordionItem pairs an AccordionTrigger with an AccordionContent panel.

components.label: Alert
components.summary: A callout box laying out an optional icon, AlertTitle, AlertDescription, and a top-right AlertAction.

components.label: Alert dialog
components.summary: The confirmation an irreversible action passes through: a Trigger opens a portalled, centered Content whose footer forces an explicit Cancel or Action choice.
components.purpose: The confirmation gate for an irreversible action. It is the only overlay that omits the close, because a destructive flow has to end in an explicit choice rather than a dismissal.
useWhen: An action deletes, removes, disconnects, resets or purges something.
An action is irreversible in any other way, or costs real money.
A bulk action applies to more rows than the user can see at once.
dontUseWhen: The action is reversible and routine — commit it and confirm with a `toast`.
The overlay is a short create or edit form — that is `dialog`, which keeps its close.

components.label: Avatar
components.summary: A user or contact image with a text fallback. Compose Avatar with AvatarImage + AvatarFallback; stack them in an AvatarGroup with an overflow count.

components.label: Badge & status tags
components.summary: A compact pill label (renders a span by default) for statuses, counts, and tags.
components.purpose: A compact label for a status, a count, or a category. The variant carries the meaning, so the meaning survives a theme change.
useWhen: A row or card needs a status, a count, or a category label.
A commodity is being tagged — with that commodity's variant and nothing else.
dontUseWhen: The label is interactive. A badge is not a button, a filter chip, or a toggle.
The state belongs to a whole surface — that is the surface's own variant, e.g. an `alert`.

components.label: Banner
components.summary: A full-width page-level strip; BannerContent centers and lays out the contents.

components.label: Breadcrumb
components.summary: A navigation trail: a Breadcrumb nav wrapping a BreadcrumbList of items, links, the current page, and separators.

components.label: Button
components.summary: A clickable button with class-variance-authority variants and sizes, including icon-only sizes.
components.purpose: The one control for committing an action. Every clickable affordance is this primitive or composes it — a styled div or anchor loses the hover, focus ring, disabled and aria-invalid handling the variants already carry.
useWhen: The user commits something: submit, save, open an overlay, trigger an export.
A secondary or utility action sits in a table toolbar or page header — as an icon button (`size="icon-sm"`/`"icon-lg"`, usually `outline` or `ghost`) with an `aria-label` and a tooltip.
A destructive action has to stay quiet in a table row — `variant="ghost-destructive"`, neutral at rest and red only on hover.
dontUseWhen: The control only navigates. An anchor is the right element; `variant="link"` styles a button to read as text, it does not make it a link.
The user is choosing among options rather than acting — that is `select`, `tabs`, or `toggle`.

components.label: Button group
components.summary: A container that visually joins adjacent buttons, with optional separators and text segments.

components.label: Calendar
components.summary: A styled react-day-picker month grid with a custom day-button renderer.

components.label: Card
components.summary: A styled container with composable header, content, and footer sections (all div-based).
components.purpose: The standard content surface: the `card` token at radius `xl`, with header, content and footer slots sharing one 1.5rem content line.
useWhen: A coherent block — a metric tile, a chart, a table — is grouped on the page background.
A surface needs to sit one step above `background` in the elevation order.
dontUseWhen: The content is itself an overlay. `popover` and `elevated` sit above `card`, and a card inside an overlay flattens the stack.
The block is a page-level message — that is `banner` or `alert`.

components.label: Category bar
components.summary: A single horizontal bar split into proportional colored segments, with an optional marker and numeric labels.

components.label: Checkbox
components.summary: A checkbox styled as a small box, with a tick when selected and a dash when indeterminate.

components.label: Circular progress
components.summary: A determinate ring, for a single figure that has a ceiling — a meter's share of its site total, or a job's completion.

components.label: Collapsible
components.summary: An open/closed disclosure: a Trigger toggles a Content panel.

components.label: Combobox
components.summary: A searchable, optionally multi-select picker: an input group plus a portalled popup list, with optional selected-value chips.

components.label: Command
components.summary: A searchable command palette; type to filter grouped, keyboard-navigable items. Wrap in CommandDialog for a ⌘K overlay.

components.label: Context menu
components.summary: A right-click menu: a Trigger region opens a portalled popup of items, checkboxes, radios, labels, and nested submenus.

components.label: Date picker
components.summary: A single-date control pairing a popover-triggering button with a Calendar.

components.label: Dialog
components.summary: A modal dialog: a Trigger opens a portalled overlay + centered Content, with styled header/footer, title, description, and close.
components.purpose: The centered modal for one short, focused action. It keeps a top-right close so a modal is always dismissible.
useWhen: A short create action of roughly one to four fields.
A focused, non-destructive confirmation.
dontUseWhen: The form is long or dense — that is a right-side `sheet`.
The action is destructive or irreversible — that is an `alert-dialog`, which omits the close on purpose.

components.label: Drawer
components.summary: A swipeable panel that slides in from an edge: a Trigger opens a portalled overlay + Content, with header/footer, title, and description.

components.label: Dropdown menu
components.summary: A menu opened from a button: a portalled popup of groups, labels, items, checkbox/radio items, separators, shortcuts, and submenus.

components.label: Empty state
components.summary: An empty-state placeholder: a dashed-border container with a header (media, title, description) and a content area for actions.

components.label: Field
components.summary: Form-field scaffolding: a Field wraps a control with a label, description, and error; group fields with FieldGroup or a FieldSet.

components.label: Hover card
components.summary: Richer detail revealed on hover or focus: a Trigger anchors a portalled, positioned Content that escapes any clipping container.
components.purpose: The richer half of the density rule: detail that would otherwise need more columns, revealed on hover or focus while the primary value stays visible in place.
useWhen: A dense table, metric tile or chart has secondary detail that does not deserve its own column.
An identifier in running text — a meter, a site, a tariff — is worth previewing without a navigation.
dontUseWhen: The detail is one short line — that is a `tooltip`, which shrink-wraps and stays transient.
The content is interactive or needs a click to open — that is a `popover`.
The information is essential to the task. Anything a user must read cannot live behind a hover.

components.label: Input
components.summary: A single-line text field with focus, disabled, and invalid states.
components.purpose: The single-line text field. It renders the destructive border and ring from `aria-invalid`, so the invalid state is a data attribute rather than a class override.
useWhen: A single line of free text or a number is entered.
It sits inside a `field`, which supplies the label, description and error slots.
dontUseWhen: The value belongs to a known set — that is `select`, `combobox`, or `radio-group`.
The control needs an affix, icon, or button inside it — that is `input-group`.

components.label: Input group
components.summary: An input with attached add-ons. Wrap an InputGroupInput (or Textarea) with InputGroupAddon slots holding icons, text, or buttons.

components.label: Input OTP
components.summary: A one-time passcode split into slots, so the length of the code is visible before it is typed.

components.label: List
components.summary: Structured rows built from the Item primitive — media, content (title + description), and trailing actions, grouped by ItemGroup.

components.label: Multi-select
components.summary: Choosing several values at once: a trigger plus a searchable checkbox listbox with Select all and Clear. The one place a checkmark belongs. The tag-style selector on this page ships as a separate registry item.

components.label: Native select
components.summary: The platform select element, styled to match the design system — for dense forms and small screens where the OS picker is the better control.

components.label: Navigation menu
components.summary: A horizontal nav bar: a List of items whose Triggers open Content panels, with an indicator arrow and a portalled viewport.

components.label: Pagination
components.summary: Page navigation for long lists and tables — previous/next controls, numbered links, and an ellipsis.

components.label: Phone input
components.summary: A phone number field whose country selector keeps the dial code and the number in a single value.

components.label: Popover
components.summary: A floating panel anchored to a trigger: PopoverContent can hold a header (title + description) and a close button.

components.label: Progress
components.summary: A progress bar: the root auto-renders a Track containing an Indicator, with optional Label and Value.

components.label: Radio group
components.summary: A set of mutually-exclusive options: a RadioGroup coordinates its RadioGroupItems.

components.label: Resizable
components.summary: Draggable split layouts: a PanelGroup arranges Panels separated by Handles.

components.label: Scroll area
components.summary: A scrollable region with a custom overlay scrollbar. Set orientation to vertical, horizontal, or both.

components.label: Select
components.summary: Choose one value from a list. A Root holds the value and wraps a Trigger plus a portalled, positioned Content of Items.
components.purpose: Choose one value from a known set. The popup is portaled to the app root and matches the trigger width, so options line up under the value they replace.
useWhen: One value is chosen from a set too long for a `tabs` strip, or from one that grows.
A recurring job needs a control — a series selector, a date range — and then the same `select` appears wherever that job does.
dontUseWhen: The set is small and fixed and the choice switches panels — that is `tabs`.
The user needs to type or search — that is `combobox`.
The list holds actions rather than values — that is a `dropdown-menu`, which shrink-wraps instead of matching the trigger.

components.label: Separator
components.summary: A thin divider line. Set orientation to horizontal (default) or vertical.

components.label: Sheet
components.summary: A dialog panel that slides in from an edge. A Trigger opens a portalled Content with header/footer, title, description, and close.
components.purpose: The edge-anchored panel for longer edit flows. 420px on the inline edges by default, full width on mobile.
useWhen: An edit or update form runs to many fields.
A detail panel should keep the page context visible behind it.
dontUseWhen: The form is one to four fields — that is a `dialog`.
The flow is a destructive confirmation — that is an `alert-dialog`.

components.label: Sidebar
components.summary: A composable application sidebar. SidebarProvider supplies collapse state; Sidebar holds a header, a scrollable body of grouped menus, and a footer, alongside a SidebarInset for the main area.
components.purpose: The application navigation frame: a provider holding collapse state, a rail, and menus whose active item uses the component's own neutral highlight.
useWhen: Top-level navigation of the app shell.
Grouped, collapsible navigation that has to survive a route change.
dontUseWhen: The switch is between panels within one page — that is `tabs`.
The list is a set of actions on one element — that is a `dropdown-menu`.

components.label: Skeleton
components.summary: A muted placeholder block for loading states; pulses by default, or shimmers with a sweeping highlight.

components.label: Slider
components.summary: A track-and-thumb control for a value or range; renders one thumb per value.

components.label: Sortable
components.summary: Drag-and-drop reordering: Sortable provides context, SortableItem wraps each entry, and SortableOverlay renders the dragged preview.

components.label: Spinner
components.summary: A spinning loading indicator with role=status.

components.label: Stepper
components.summary: A multi-step progress flow: a nav of items (trigger, indicator, separator, title, description) with switchable content panels.

components.label: Switch
components.summary: An on/off toggle with a sliding thumb.

components.label: Table
components.summary: A styled HTML table wrapped for horizontal overflow — header, body, optional footer, rows, cells, and a caption.
components.purpose: The data grid for text-first rows. It ships the row hover and the alignment that make every table in the product match.
useWhen: Data reads as rows and columns.
Density is high and secondary detail can move into a `tooltip` or `hover-card` rather than another column.
dontUseWhen: The rows are actions or navigation — that is a menu or the `sidebar`.
There is no data to show — that is `empty`, in the table's place.

components.label: Tabs
components.summary: A tabbed interface: a List of Triggers reveals matching Content panels.

components.label: Tags
components.summary: A field for entering and removing multiple tag chips, with paste-splitting and validation.

components.label: Timeline
components.summary: A vertical sequence of events. Each TimelineItem pairs a status TimelineDot with a TimelineHeading and TimelineContent, connected by a TimelineLine.

components.label: Toast
components.summary: App-wide notifications: mount one Toaster near the app root, then call the imperative toast() function to show messages.
components.purpose: App-wide feedback for a completed interaction. One `Toaster` is mounted near the app root; everything else is the imperative `toast()` call from `sonner`.
useWhen: An interaction has no other visible result — a saved form, a toggled switch.
The outcome of a destructive action needs reporting after its confirmation.
dontUseWhen: The message belongs to one field — that is inline validation through `field`.
The message is a persistent page-level condition — that is `banner` or `alert`.

components.label: Toggle
components.summary: A two-state button that holds a pressed/on state.

components.label: Tooltip
components.summary: A hover hint: a Provider shares timing, a Trigger reveals a portalled Content on hover/focus.
